mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.SeatGradeMapper.list */ SELECT SG.SEAT_GRADE_ID AS seatGradeId , SG.SHOW_DATE_ID AS showDateId , SG.SHOW_ID AS showId , SG.SEAT_COUNT AS seatCount , SG.PRICE AS price , SG.GRADE_NAME AS gradeName , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT S WHERE S.SEAT_GRADE_ID = SG.SEAT_GRADE_ID AND IFNULL(S.SEAT_STATUS, 'available') = 'available' ) AS remainCount FROM SEAT_GRADE SG WHERE 1 = 1 AND SG.SHOW_DATE_ID = #{showDateId} ORDER BY SG.SEAT_GRADE_ID ASC
